result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical duplicate cards ('Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, delivery time and fee) side by side, which looks like a data/rendering defect. Other elements (partially visible third carousel card and the card cut off at the bottom) are expected scroll/viewport behavior and not defects.

issues.description: Duplicate restaurant cards: the first two items in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel are identical ('Green Bowl Poké', same image, 15–25 min badge, €0.90 delivery), making the row look like a rendering/data bug rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel renders unique restaurants; deduplicate the data source or vary the cards (different restaurant/image) so repeated entries are not shown adjacently.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges ('15–25 min') on the first two carousel cards overlap the card images' bottom-left corner inconsistently with the third card's badge placement, and the badge on the second card slightly overlaps the first card's edge region, creating a cramped look.
issues.suggestion: Align badge placement consistently within each card (same offset from card edges) and add spacing so badges never visually collide between adjacent cards.
